items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: Dialog with a search field and MenuList rows: substring filter, ArrowDown into the rows, Enter runs and closes, Esc returns focus to the trigger, Ctrl/Cmd+K opens it. Copy the file next to your app shell.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Pass `commands` and `onRun`. The rows are a MenuList (listbox); typing never moves focus out of the field until ArrowDown. A notification-centre block was considered and rejected.
